evidence.locator: Interest expense decreased primarily due to maturities of commercial paper and higher capitalization of debt interest expense, offset in part by higher finance lease interest expense.

research.rationale: Note 12 tax-position interest net of income-tax benefits; expense or closing accrual, not cash or a parent input.

binding.location_and_scope: Note 10 Debt explicitly **cash paid for interest on debt**. Retain narrow scope despite generic tag; not total all-in interest or interest expense.

annotations.rationale: Note 13 finance-lease liability-measurement cash, reported operating cash flow; separate from debt cash and principal.

binding.location_and_scope: Note 3 Other income (expense): accrued non-operating interest expense; do not substitute for cash paid or assume all lease/capitalized interest included.
